statement: Whenever kth_palindrome(queries, intLength) returns a result r, let L = intLength and let C = 9 * 10^(ceil(L/2) - 1), the number of positive palindromes whose decimal representation has exactly L digits. Then len(r) = len(queries), and for every i with 0 <= i < len(queries): if queries[i] > C then r[i] = -1; if queries[i] <= C then r[i] is the unique positive integer whose decimal representation has exactly L digits, reads the same forwards and backwards, and has exactly queries[i] - 1 positive L-digit palindromes strictly less than it.
preconditions: len(queries) is between 1 and 50000 inclusive, for every i with 0 <= i < len(queries), 1 <= queries[i] <= 1000000000, and 1 <= intLength <= 15.
